Definition: to restrain or (reflex.) refrain; by implication, to refuse, spare, preserve; to observe
BiblicalUsage: 1) to withhold, restrain, hold back, keep in check, refrain; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to withhold, keep back, keep for oneself, keep from, hold in check, refrain, spare, reserve; 1a2) to restrain, check; 1b) (Niphal) to assuage, be spared
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
